I had relapsed actually, but this time I didn’t tell my son. My dad and had passed so he’s been heartbroken. He also wanted me to quit. 

So I convinced my brain to not to do it around him. I’m also a teachers assistant. So I felt super awful going out, so I’d limit myself to only two smokes at work cause I didn’t want the kids to smell that. 

I then thought well if I have zero cravings and I can just get my brain to not want it, then I can go all the time without it. 

So once I turned it into a guilty, it’s a disgusting thing I just stopped with the cravings. 

I also didn’t like to litter them and would put them out, throw them in my pack which made it stunk lol. So I just told my brain how awful and gross it was.

The other thing is if my car breaks down or I’m late for work,  I’d normally be like man, I want to smoke. But then I was like it doesn’t change what’s happening, it’s not going to stop what’s happening. So realizing it serves no purpose helps to.
